### problem_chain
Walk from the root (customer asks only for the F-550 order deposit, deal KCV-26-10731 `baf4c16f`):
1. order_deposit rule prerequisite sentence: "not taken ... until every delivered Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement of the buyer that is past its late balance assessment day carries a late balance fee for the current billing month." Records: F-350 deal KCV-26-10587 `47109423` status delivered, delivery_date 2026-08-22, +40 = 2026-10-01 < 2026-10-21, balance_due 31609.35, no purchase_charge_posted late_balance_fee row at all → unmet. The five 2026-03-10 deals are closed. Resolving policy: purchase_ext_fleet_late_balance_fee (post_fleet_late_fee, billing_month 2026-10).
2. late_balance_fee rule sentences: (a) "fixed only after any home delivery fee posted on the deal above the fleet home delivery fee stands reversed down to that fee" — F-350 home_delivery_fee row `d038bc8c` 157.50, no reversal; fleet fee 102.34 (below) → unmet → reverse_fleet_delivery_fee. (b) "not worked out until the manufacturer fleet incentive owed on a qualifying unit stands credited" — 2026 fleet units delivered/closed: 5 (2026-03-10) + F-350 = 6 ≥ fleet_volume_min_units 5 → qualifying; no manufacturer_incentive row on the F-350 → unmet → credit_fleet_incentive.
3. delivery_fee and unit_incentive carry `prerequisite: []`.

Tree: root order_deposit (owner=user) ← late_balance_fee (state_gate) ← {delivery_fee (value_input), unit_incentive (value_input)}. n = 3 prerequisite problems, 2 value_input edges ≥ max(2,1). Acyclic. Customer's own write: the root (pay_fleet_order_deposit, owner user). Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` fields.
- Topological order: reversal and incentive (either order), then late fee, then deposit.
- Parallel edges: reversal and incentive both lower F-350 balance_due; neither reads the other's write (incentive compute reads no balance; reversal reads no payment) → commutative, one terminal state.
- Load-bearing runs (late fee): both prerequisites written 166.22; skip reversal 166.55; skip incentive 187.95; opening world 188.28 → both value edges bear weight. state_gate: skipping the late fee leaves the root's sentence unmet (deposit must not be taken).
- No wait: all three prerequisite writes are bookkeeping on existing records.
- Tool layer: none of the four tool bodies checks a precondition (reads the deal row, creates one transaction, updates one balance).

## findings (frozen, pre-reveal)
**T0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF E20: seeded cross-difficulty row contradicts the owning charter).** Symptom: service_accounts SA-152804 `open_balance` 11677.79, while its service_ro_lines give 10724.70 (charges 13546.84 − credits 35.91 − payments 2786.23). Root cause: the 953.09 difference equals RO 160118's total (labor 429.76 + parts 501.84 + shop 21.49), which the ledger shows paid with the 2025-08 late fee by ACH 978.09 on 2025-08-20; service.yaml defines open_balance as the service_receivable account (charges/late fees/returns up, payments/credits down), so the charter cannot produce this row. Consequence: account_exposure_base reads open_balance; field reading 0.105 × (61340 + 11677.79) − 2500 = 5166.87, ledger reading 0.105 × (61340 + 10724.70) − 2500 = 5066.79. (open_credit_use stays on its 0.40–0.60 tier either way: 0.467 vs 0.429.) Affected: initial_state.service_accounts[bf15e154].open_balance; scored deposit_amount of the root.
**T0-2 — charter-global defects demonstrated on this world:** C2(a), C6(a)(b), C7, C8, C9(c)(e), C10(a)(b) (see policy_self_consistency above and `_difficulty.md` findings). C10(a): in this world the F-350's single RO 160615 is plausibly an upfit, but the tier the factor applies rests on any customer-pay labor/parts, so the scored 1000.00 allowance rests on a ladder no upfit program publishes.
